name: Phantom Warrior

source.note: Curse of Strahd appendix block (2016) in the 2024 layout. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Its Armor Class, the sword's damage type and its resistances need the book. Resistance to nonmagical weapons is entered as plain Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing resistance.

languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.summary: Sees 60 ft into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.

actions.name: Spectral Longsword
actions.summary: A ghostly blade that cuts with force.

summary: The ghost of a fallen knight, still fighting: two spectral sword strokes, and it walks through walls.
